whatThisIs: Match each prescription to an eligible encounter under a covered entity's own look-back, registered-site and referral policies. Every prescription receives an eligibility decision and the first rule it failed.
whenToUse: Use this to produce a local audit trail from the entity's prescription, encounter, eligible-prescriber and registered-site files. The files remain in the browser tab.
inputs: Four CSV or TSV files: prescriptions with patient reference, prescriber NPI, NDC, fill date, pharmacy and orphan-designation status; encounters with patient reference, date, location and provider NPI; eligible prescribers with relationship; and registered sites. Also enter the entity type, look-back days and referral policy.
output: Eligible and ineligible prescriptions with reasons and matched encounter details, match rates by pharmacy and prescriber, and full or patient-redacted CSV downloads.
